us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: US national debt reaches $40 trillion
bullets: The Treasury reported total federal debt above $40 trillion for the first time.
AP said the milestone renewed warnings about deficits, interest costs and federal spending.
The figure comes as bond-market pressure remains a focus for investors and policymakers.

articles.title: Trump shows reporters White House helipad and ballroom work
bullets: President Trump led reporters around the White House construction site on Wednesday.
AP reported he showed work on a South Lawn helipad and discussed the ballroom project.
The ballroom remains tied up in legal challenges over construction authority.

articles.title: US sanctions ICC president and senior prosecution lawyer
bullets: The Trump administration imposed sanctions on ICC President Tomoko Akane and lawyer Abdoulaye Seye.
The ICC called the sanctions a flagrant attack on the tribunal’s independence.
Japan criticized the move as unfortunate in a rare public rebuke of Washington.

articles.title: Trump names nine new federal judicial nominees
bullets: Trump announced a slate of nine judicial nominees ahead of the midterms.
Reuters reported the list includes an Oklahoma attorney tied to religious charter-school litigation.
The nominations add to the administration’s broader push to reshape the federal judiciary.

articles.title: Former Meta engineer testifies on teen-safety practices
bullets: A former Meta engineer said the company used a “don’t ask, don’t tell” approach on child users.
The testimony came in litigation over Instagram, Facebook and teen safety.
Parents of children harmed by social media platforms protested outside the Oakland courthouse.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Top worldwide stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Russian barrage kills at least 14 in Kyiv region
bullets: Russia launched missiles and drones at Kyiv and surrounding areas overnight.
Officials said at least 14 people were killed and more were injured.
Ukraine continues to seek more Patriot interceptors for ballistic-missile defense.

articles.title: North Korea fires barrage of short-range missiles
bullets: South Korea said North Korea fired about 10 short-range ballistic missiles toward the sea.
The launches followed a US move to scale back joint drills with South Korea.
The missile test came despite Trump signaling interest in renewed talks with Kim Jong Un.

articles.title: Hopes fade after Central African Republic mine collapse
bullets: More than 100 people were reported dead after an artisanal gold mine collapsed.
Officials said others remained missing or trapped under debris.
The collapse occurred in Zamboye, near the Cameroon border.

articles.title: Tanker off Yemen hijacked and diverted, UKMTO says
bullets: The National reported a tanker off Yemen was hijacked and diverted, citing UKMTO.
The incident unfolded amid heightened tensions around the US-Iran conflict and Red Sea shipping.
Maritime-security risks remain elevated near Yemen and key Gulf routes.

articles.title: Syrian foreign minister makes first Pakistan visit in 19 years
bullets: Syria’s Foreign Minister Asaad Al Shibani began a high-level visit to Pakistan.
The National said it was the first such visit by a senior Syrian official in 19 years.
Talks were expected to cover bilateral ties and regional tensions.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India-focused stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Kolkata hotel fire kills at least nine people
bullets: Reuters reported at least nine deaths, including a child, in a Kolkata hotel fire.
Police said the fire began around 2:50 a.m. on the building’s second floor.
About 30 people were evacuated, and officials were still determining the exact cause.

articles.title: Supreme Court orders tougher action on bulk-waste violators
bullets: India’s Supreme Court addressed violations of Solid Waste Management Rules.
LiveLaw reported the court said power and water can be disconnected for noncompliant bulk-waste generators.
The order targets enforcement against large waste producers that ignore legal obligations.

articles.title: Supreme Court clarifies negligence standard in motor-accident claims
bullets: The Supreme Court explained principles for motor-accident compensation claims.
LiveLaw reported that acquittal in a criminal case alone does not prove absence of negligence.
The ruling addresses how tribunals should assess civil liability separately from criminal outcomes.

articles.title: India markets regulator pursues reforms to attract foreign investors
bullets: Reuters reported India’s markets regulator is focusing on reforms to reverse foreign capital flight.
The measures are aimed at easing participation and improving trading access for overseas investors.
The story comes amid pressure on Indian markets from outflows and global volatility.

articles.title: India removes barricades outside Pakistan High Commission in Delhi
bullets: Hindustan Times reported India removed safety barricades and bollards outside Pakistan’s High Commission.
The move was listed among major India updates on August 20.
The change comes amid continued scrutiny of India-Pakistan diplomatic security arrangements.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Top market movers and market-driving stories

articles.title: Moderna shares surge after mRNA cancer-treatment trial success
bullets: Moderna said its experimental personalized mRNA cancer treatment passed a key late-stage test.
The therapy is being developed with Merck and used with Keytruda for melanoma patients.
AP reported Moderna shares surged after the announcement.

articles.title: Walmart stock drops after cautious outlook
bullets: AP reported Walmart shares slid more than 6% before Thursday’s market open.
The move followed a cautious outlook from the retail giant.
The decline weighed on attention around consumer spending and tariff-related inflation risks.

articles.title: Semiconductor selloff weighs on Wall Street
bullets: Reuters reported Wall Street closed lower as semiconductors led technology declines.
Nvidia fell 2.26% in the session cited by Reuters.
Higher bond yields and Middle East uncertainty pressured richly valued tech stocks.

articles.title: Paramount Skydance among CNBC’s biggest midday movers
bullets: CNBC listed Paramount Skydance among the stocks making major midday moves.
The same roundup also highlighted Cava, Capri and SailPoint.
The article came during a session marked by rotation away from megacap technology names.

articles.title: US stock futures steady after tech-led slump
bullets: Reuters said US stock-index futures were stable after a technology-driven Wall Street selloff.
Investors focused on inflation expectations and Middle East tensions.
Bond-yield volatility remained a key driver for equities.

articles.title: Treasury debt milestone renews fiscal warnings
bullets: US federal debt crossed the $40 trillion threshold.
AP said the milestone intensified debate over fiscal sustainability and interest costs.
The story affected bond-market discussions as yields remained under pressure.

articles.title: Alibaba AI spending dents profit despite revenue growth
bullets: Nikkei Asia reported Alibaba’s AI outlays weighed on profit.
The company still posted its best revenue growth in years, according to the report.
The results highlight the cost of competing aggressively in artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Samsung Electronics poised for $72 billion shareholder-return plan
bullets: Nikkei Asia reported Samsung was expected to approve a $72 billion shareholder-return program.
The board meeting was expected on August 21.
The move reflects strong cash generation tied to semiconductor and AI demand.

articles.title: HAECO and China Aircraft Leasing plan Hong Kong maintenance hub
bullets: SCMP reported HAECO and China Aircraft Leasing Group signed an MOU.
The companies plan to build an aircraft-engine maintenance hub in Hong Kong.
Initial work will focus on quick-turn services, hospital repair and engine asset management.

articles.title: Hormuz shipping remains unchanged despite US-Iran stalemate
bullets: Reuters reported shipping through Hormuz was unchanged despite the US-Iran stalemate.
The waterway remains central to global oil and gas trade flows.
Markets continued watching the region for risks to energy supply and freight movement.

articles.title: Former Meta engineer says company prioritized growth over child safety
bullets: A former Meta director testified about internal approaches to child users.
AP reported the case centers on teen safety and platform-design practices.
Parents demonstrated outside the Oakland courthouse during the proceedings.

articles.title: China’s Unitree soars in blockbuster market debut
bullets: Reuters reported China’s Unitree Robotics surged nearly sixfold in its debut.
The listing underscored strong investor appetite for humanoid-robotics exposure.
The company is known for viral robots that perform athletic demonstrations.

articles.title: Meta reportedly preparing Hypernova smart glasses reveal
bullets: CNBC reported Meta plans to unveil Hypernova smart glasses at Connect next month.
The device is expected to include a display and a wristband interface.
The product would extend Meta’s push into wearable AI and mixed-reality hardware.

articles.title: Netflix sued by Demon Hunter over ‘KPop Demon Hunters’
bullets: Reuters reported the band Demon Hunter sued Netflix over ‘KPop Demon Hunters.’
The case concerns alleged intellectual-property issues tied to the entertainment property.
The dispute adds to legal scrutiny around streaming content and brand rights.

articles.title: Alibaba’s AI push weighs on earnings
bullets: Nikkei Asia reported Alibaba’s heavy AI investment reduced profit.
The company continued spending on artificial-intelligence infrastructure and services.
The results show how major tech firms are absorbing near-term costs to compete in AI.
